description: Stages, transitions, gates, gap kinds and exception kinds of the Harness CTHA DAG. The plan states these as Markdown tables; a table cannot answer whether a stage is a legal successor or whether a gate is required, so they live here as data.

stage_states.note: Declared in the DAG, never dispatched.
A FlowRequest was sent; no result yet.
The only state that produces a transition.
Produced output, but not enough to certify the stage.
A required gate failed or a precondition is missing.
Waiting on a human decision recorded in decisions_required.

stages.purpose: Prove the tooling, registry and state are usable before spending a specialist on anything.
Produce a ContextPackage tied to a revision, with resolvable anchors.
Turn confirmed documentation into an approved requirement package.
Derive proposal, spec, design and tasks from an approved requirement.
Produce a validated migration triad without applying anything.
Implement the tasks under strict TDD and certify a candidate commit.
Reconverge Graphify, Engram and documentation on the candidate commit.
Hold delivered artifacts awaiting an external pipeline.
stages.gateless_reason: A holding state. It runs no command; the gates that justify it already passed in ddl and code-knowledge-refresh.

stages.purpose: Accept and authenticate the receipt of an application performed outside the harness.
Re-snapshot the catalog and confirm the deployed state matches what was delivered.
Close a change that was delivered but not deployed.
stages.gateless_reason: Archive records; it verifies nothing of its own. Its preconditions are the gates of the stage that fed it.

stages.purpose: Close a change whose deployment was verified by an ApplyReceipt.
stages.gateless_reason: Archive records; it verifies nothing of its own.

transitions.condition: Tooling, registry and state are valid.
Requirement package and Approval are complete.
Proposal, spec, design and tasks complete, no DB change.
Planning artifacts identify a schema change.
Triad, ValidationReport and DeliveryManifest are valid.
Candidate commit clean, gates and fresh review PASS.
Convergence reached and an external apply is requested.
Convergence reached and no external apply is requested.
An external pipeline applied the artifacts.
Catalog, db-graph and code knowledge show no drift.

gates.verifies: Every installed launcher resolves to an existing target and matches the installed version (source -> dist -> launcher parity).
Every registered unit, db project and skill claim holds against the filesystem.
state_revision and fencing token are current and no divergent history exists.
The corpus is under version control and the assessment is attributable to a commit and tree.
The graph has nodes, a recorded generator version and a digest-bound build stamp — not merely a directory that exists.
Graph anchors resolve to files in this working tree, not a different one.
Every consumed document is inventoried with path, hash and provenance.
The protected feature set and the preservation argument exist before any change is authorized.
No contradiction between code and documentation is left open.
Every req/* reference and digest named by Approval was consumed unchanged.
The spec carries executable scenarios, not restated intent.
Estimated review workload is computed against max_review_lines and a delivery strategy is resolved.
Desired-state DDL parses and unsupported statements are declared rather than skipped.
The plan targets the server version actually deployed.
Statements that cannot run inside a transaction are isolated and declared.
Acquired lock levels fit the declared lock budget.
Full-table rewrites are identified and fit the downtime budget.
The down script restores the prior state, or the irreversibility is explicitly approved.
Up and down execute against a snapshot of the deployed catalog.
The deployed catalog and the desired state agree. Drift blocks; it is never reconciled silently.
The evidence describes the candidate commit and not uncommitted edits on top of it.
The candidate commit builds from a clean tree.
The project's own static checks pass on the candidate commit.
The full suite passes on the candidate commit, including the regressions that protect protected_features.
An independent reviewer with fresh context judged the same commit and tree. Any later edit invalidates it.
Graphify and its stamp were rebuilt at the candidate commit.
OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Mermaid and Gherkin artifacts validate.
No blocking gap remains between code, graph, memory and documentation.
The receipt authenticates target, run, DeliveryManifest digest, applied up digest and post-snapshot.
A fresh catalog snapshot shows no drift against the delivered desired state.
db-graph was rebuilt from the post-apply catalog.

gap_kinds.detail: No graph.json exists for the unit; a directory holding only a report is not a graph.
The graph has no digest-bound build stamp, so it cannot be tied to a generator version or a commit.
The stamp records a different commit than the current tree.
A source_file referenced by the graph no longer exists. Blocking once the unresolved share crosses the sufficiency threshold.
A source file the graph never indexed, per graphify's own manifest.
No graphify manifest, so what the graph covered cannot be established.
A file the graph manifest says it indexed no longer exists in the working tree.
The corpus is not under version control, so no claim about it can be re-verified later.
No authorized PostgreSQL catalog snapshot; deployed truth is unknown.
Deployed catalog and desired state disagree.
A DDL statement outside declared parser coverage. Blocking when it affects the target objects.
A document with no inventory entry, hash or provenance; it cannot authorize a change.
Code and documentation disagree and no decision has been recorded.
No Approval binds the exact derived artifacts and digests.
The protected feature set could not be established, so no preservation argument exists.
No runnable test command, so strict TDD cannot be observed and no gate can produce evidence.

exceptions.grants: Allows a single PR to exceed constraints.max_review_lines instead of splitting into a chain.
exceptions.still_required: Every implementation gate. The exception buys review budget, never a skipped gate.

exceptions.grants: Allows an optional gate to report skipped.
exceptions.still_required: A skip_reason. A required gate can never take this exception.

exceptions.grants: Allows implementation without an observed RED before GREEN.
exceptions.still_required: A recorded reason, normally test-runner-missing. Waiving it does not waive the test gate.

exceptions.grants: Allows a DDL diagnosis built on a non-transactional or partial catalog snapshot.
exceptions.still_required: The result can only reach partial. It never authorizes final SQL.

exceptions.grants: Allows installing a remote artifact with no verifiable signature or attestation.
exceptions.granted_by: human, in an interactive session only
exceptions.still_required: Explicit textual confirmation. Forbidden under --non-interactive or with CI set.
